type: Tutorial type-104 Drifting_Piece placement +0xE4 -> type-147 waypoint list; count/capacity +8/+12, size word +16, array pointer +20; each type-148 waypoint stores f32be xyz at +0x20/+0x24/+0x28
structure: A drifting prop must translate its private waypoint positions with its placement position to move its visible animation
meaning: Changing only Drifting_Piece_ID1 +0x24 xyz reached the loaded archive and RAM but did not give the requested visible displacement (user observation). Drifting_Piece.ai uses Target Waypoint, Waypoint Index and Offset_Distance, then a displace instruction. Translating all three private waypoint xyz triples by the same delta as the placement made the island visibly move; the user confirmed the first run and the second byte-identical boot reproduced a displaced animated island. Editable scope: translation of existing private waypoint xyz for this tutorial Drifting_Piece layout, alongside the anchor. Refuse missing runtime pointer evidence, different record classes, invalid arrays and shared lists/points. No new records, pointer edits, script instruction/timing edits, geometry or collision edits; this is not an M4/M5 gate result. Other behaviours remain unsupported.

evidence.summary: Anchor-only control: rebuilt archive consumed at 15333 kB versus original 15241 kB; edited xyz found in MEM1 at 0x80f90a08, but user reported no visible movement. Demonstrates that archive consumption is insufficient to validate a visual edit.
